limitations: Forced best-fit labels from clothing crops only. Plain garments do not identify a reeve, and brown fur, blue wool, belts and buttons cannot reliably separate gentry from merchants. Earl labels describe visual costume signaling, not historically definitive rank attribution. No counts were assumed and no source identities, metadata or other images were inspected.
